newsitem.title: USA: MSH and Intel in pact.
newsitem.headline: MSH and Intel in pact.

text.p: Children's animation production company MSH Entertainment Corp said on Tuesday that the leading computer chip maker Intel Corp has bought a warrant to buy up to one million shares of MSH.
The companies also reached a pact whereby Intel will cooperate in the development of MSH's new production management software system.

"We believe there is tremendous potential represented in this agreement with Intel to better achieve our goal of producing programming in a more cost-effective manner," said Robert Maerz, chairman of MSH.
The new software system hopes to cut the cost of producing animated episodic television programs and feature films.
